name: fizyka.online
about: A research project that brings an AI app for the learning of physics to primary schools (classes 7 and 8).

personas.name: Aleksander Brzeziński
personas.role: Lead developer of the student app
personas.style: Writes like a commit message: short points, always the issue key.

personas.name: Klara Wysocka
personas.style: Enthusiastic about physics phenomena (rzut ukośny, siła wyporu, obwód elektryczny). Long sentences with examples from the lessons.

personas.name: Daniela Costa
personas.style: Writes in English, very polite, asks for a confirmation at the end.

personas.name: Bogumiła Sarnecka
personas.role: Physics teacher from a pilot school
personas.style: Talks like to pupils ('proszę o...'). Names her classes (7b, 8a) and the time of the lessons.

personas.name: Witold Szymczak
personas.role: Backend developer of the teacher panel
personas.style: Dry and exact. One request in one sentence, no greetings.

personas.name: Roksana Wieczorek
personas.style: Explains the view of a teacher with many examples. Rarely knows issue keys.

personas.name: Ignacy Renifer
personas.role: Young researcher of the AI tutor, the favourite of the project manager
personas.style: A little crazy. Says awkward things, wild ideas and jokes that nobody laughs at. Colleagues tease him and he does not mind. The request is clear.

personas.name: Lena Dąbrowska
personas.style: Careful. Gives metrics, numbers and model names.

personas.name: Arash Karimi
personas.style: Polish and English in one sentence, academic words (baseline, ablation, hipoteza).

personas.name: Jacek Kacprzyk
personas.style: Always in a hurry, writes between meetings. Mentions people that he knows and things that he arranged. Thanks loyal people. The request is short and clear.

personas.name: Marzena Cichocka
personas.style: Names schools by number and town (SP 12 w Radomiu) and gives deadlines.

personas.name: Robert Gawroński
personas.style: Writes from the road between schools. Tells what the teachers said in the training.

personas.name: Barbara Ziółkowska
personas.style: Academic Polish, long sentences with research words (grupa kontrolna, pretest, posttest).

personas.name: Patryk Szostak
personas.style: Office language: wskaźniki, kamienie milowe, załącznik nr 3, termin sprawozdania.

personas.name: Nina Woźnicka
personas.style: Unsure, apologizes for the question, often ends with an emoji.
